name: Distilled Abyssal Brine
taste: salt, rust and something bitter underneath
lore: Seawater boiled down from the deepest trenches, where nothing should live.

name: Rendered Wyvern Fat
lore: Rendered slowly over a peat fire; a wyvern's fat never fully sets.

name: Bog-Lantern Dew
lore: Gathered at dawn from moss where marsh-lights were seen the night before.

name: Thawed Glacial Ichor
taste: nothing at all, then a deep ache in the teeth
lore: Melted from blue ice older than any kingdom.

name: Twice-Distilled Ether Wine
lore: Wine distilled twice, the second time under a new moon.

name: Fuming Black Vitriol
lore: Oil of vitriol, left to fume until it blackens.

name: Condensed Hellhound Saliva
lore: Collected from a hellhound's bowl. The bowl was iron; it is now slag.

name: Fermented Feywild Nectar
taste: peach, honey and a spark on the tongue
lore: Nectar from flowers that bloom only where the fey have danced.

name: Sublimated Quicksilver
taste: cold metal (it should not be tasted)
lore: Quicksilver sublimated seven times until it remembers it was once a vapour.

name: Condensate of Solar Tears
lore: Dew collected from a temple roof at the solstice sunrise.

name: Clarified Barrow-Milk
lore: The white seep that gathers in the lowest chamber of a barrow.

name: Liquid Silver Sea Mist
taste: like remembering something you never saw
lore: Mist from the Astral Sea, caught in a bottle and slowly made heavy.

name: Dryad's Spring Water
lore: Drawn from a spring at the roots of a dryad's tree, with her leave.

name: Fermented Mossbrew
lore: A hedge-alchemist's base: moss and barley left to work in a cellar.

name: Storm-Bottled Rainwater
taste: sharp, like licking a coin in a thunderstorm
lore: Rain caught in an open jar on a rooftop during a lightning storm.

name: Distilled Gale Essence
taste: like a gasp of mountain air
lore: Wind from a mountain pass, distilled until it can be poured.

name: Moonwell Water
lore: Water from a well that reflects the moon even on moonless nights.

name: Leyline-Seep Brine
lore: Salt water seeping from rock where lines of magic cross.

name: Smelter's Brimstone Spirit
lore: Spirit condensed from the chimneys of a smelter.

name: Yeti-Den Snowmelt
lore: Snow melted from the mouth of a yeti's den — quickly.
